name: What is AEO and how does it benefit real estate agents?

mainEntity.name: What is AEO and how does it benefit real estate agents?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO, or Answer Engine Optimization, focuses on making your digital content easily discoverable and understandable by AI-powered search engines and voice assistants. For real estate agents, this means your property listings, agent profiles, and local market insights can appear directly in search answers, enhancing visibility and credibility. It helps capture leads from users asking specific questions about properties, neighborhoods, or real estate processes, positioning you as an authoritative local expert.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO helps real estate agents appear in AI-powered search answers and voice assistant responses, increasing visibility and lead generation by addressing specific user queries directly.
